quarterly_data.signal: Chairman and general manager Wang Chenghai (H1 2026 collective results briefing): the planned subsidiary Dingtong Liquid Cooling (Xinyang) Technology is mainly a vehicle for new capacity, to make optical-module liquid-cooling heat-sink modules, manifolds and micro-channel cold plates. Board secretary Wang Xiaolan said orders on hand are sufficient and the company keeps co-developing new projects with customers.
